title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Reveals First Trailer, Visual, and Main Cast Ahead of October Premiere
content: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life has revealed its first teaser trailer, teaser visual, main cast, and staff ahead of its October 2026 premiere. The anime was announced in February.
author: Anime Corner

title: Pokémon Pokopia Game Offers Expansion Pass DLC, Free Update in August
content: Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Tuesday that Pokémon Pokopia , its cozy-style life simulation crafting game for the Pokémon franchise, will offer paid Expansion Pass DLC, as well as a free update in August.
author: ANN

title: Star Fox Switch 2 Game Remake Launches Playable Demo
content: Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Tuesday that Star Fox , a remake of Star Fox 64 with new graphics, new art style, a multiplayer option, and other gameplay additions, would debut a playable demo later that day. The game will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on June 25.
author: ANN
